risks.quote: While many students now turn to generative AI for advice during difficult periods, these tools are not designed to address complex emotional or mental health concerns. Their guidance may be incomplete or even misleading, particularly if you’re facing more serious difficulties.

responsibilities.quote: Apply the MIC Academic Integrity policy and follow the procedure outlined if you encounter a suspected breach of academic integrity.
Please note that the MIC Academic Integrity Policy is currently under review and an updated Policy will be made available in due course.
